title: Refund Window and Timeline Policy
content: Customers are eligible for a full refund on purchases made within 30 days of the purchase date. The charge must be in a succeeded status. Refunds are processed back to the original payment method within 5-10 business days.

title: Damaged Goods and Returns Policy
content: If item arrives damaged, customers must report it within 7 days of delivery. Photographic evidence of damage is required. A replacement will be shipped or a refund issued immediately upon verification.

title: Subscription Cancellation Policy
content: Subscriptions can be cancelled at any time through the customer portal. Cancellation takes effect at the end of the current billing cycle. No partial refunds are provided for mid-cycle cancellations.

title: Lost Shipment Policy
content: A shipment is considered lost if it is not delivered within 15 business days for domestic orders or 30 days for international. Once verified, we will issue a replacement shipment or store credit.

title: Pricing Disputes and Adjustments
content: If a customer claims they were charged incorrectly, support must verify the charge amount against the invoice. Price matching is only valid against our official promotional campaigns within 7 days of purchase.
